# gsm_project_autoscaling_group (Resource)

Manages an autoscaling group owned by a project. Squadrons in every environment of the project can reference it by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "gsm_project_autoscaling_group" "default" {
  project_id             = "<project_id>"
  autoscaling_group_name = "docs-asg"

  targets {
    cluster_name = "<cluster_name>"
    weight       = 100
    max_pods     = 40
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `autoscaling_group_name` (String) Name of the autoscaling group
- `project_id` (String) Project ID where the autoscaling group belongs

### Optional

- `targets` (Block List) Clusters that game servers of this group are scaled onto (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--targets))
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--targets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `targets`

Required:

- `cluster_name` (String) Cluster name. The cluster must be registered to the project.
- `weight` (Number) Weight for this cluster in autoscaling distribution

Optional:

- `max_pods` (Number) Maximum number of game server pods that can be deployed to this cluster


<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `default` (String)
